name: Mielon's The Sift
description:
Explore 11 biomes across the surface and underground, from Coral Forests and the Organic Desert to Ichor-Snowy Peaks and Soulshale Caves. The dimension has its own animated sky, weather, and three-part tide cycle. Beds work during Endure Tide or thunderstorms.

Search Abandoned Camps, Ruined Portals, Ichor Domes, and Soulshale Shelters for loot. Follow explorer maps to remote camps and the Sculkers’ Lair, a buried dungeon patrolled by Stalkers and Scavengers.
